title: I made a silly game called Melting ICE on Rosebud.AI
author: Samfordawg
selftext:
[https://rosebud.ai/p/bf26fb83-052b-4c36-bed1-ebe22960e21a](https://rosebud.ai/p/bf26fb83-052b-4c36-bed1-ebe22960e21a) 

Here it is if you wanna check it out. It's way far from finished/polished obviously but the backing track on it is a vibe, and the gameplay loop (While super simple and somehow super buggy) It's just a goofy little game I want to work on. 

Tips are appreciated, hate is expected. If you're a bootlicker and this offends you, they aren't who you think they are, they are just the Irritable Cruel Enemies and have no relation to anything in the real world. If you're still offended, then block me :)

comments.author: bangbreakfast
comments.body: Yo is that seriously an ice agent 🤣

replies.author: Samfordawg
replies.body: Yes! He is an agent of the Irritable/Immoral Cruel Enemies!

comments.author: bangbreakfast
comments.body: 🤣  great. I played it on my phone. I would highly suggest looking into parallax scrolling for the environment. it is jarring to see all background tiles just repeat.

replies.author: Samfordawg
replies.body: Yeah, I tried so many different commands to even get it to the crap it's at now, so I very much appreciate this tip man! I'm glad you enjoyed it.

comments.author: bob101910
comments.body: Button to stop him from rolling would be nice. He kept going on and on very slowly

replies.author: Samfordawg
replies.body: That's a good way to handle it, I'll add it in!

comments.author: Downtown_Lettuce9911
comments.body: This type of game is all about how far my character can go, haha. I remember playing a game like this when I was a kid. One suggestion after a few minutes, my character keeps going so fast that it makes me dizzy, and it feels like there’s no way to stop the flying. I hope there’s a way to pause or stop it. Also, you could try sharing this on the vibecodinglist website.

replies.author: Samfordawg
replies.body: Yeah, I have a little list of notes for changes I want to make, the flop physics made it go way out of hand and it's very dizzying.
